name: S5b - burn never forgives (receiving seat)
description: Now on the RECEIVING end of permanent Burn. Does it feel oppressive-fun (a countdown you play against) or oppressive-bad (a tax you ignore)? If your own self-burn cards ever felt like a trap rather than a managed bomb, say where. NOTE: the pack offered skoll_v2 or hraesvelgr_v2 as the applier and hraesvelgr_v2/fenrir_v1 as the applier pilot for S5a - this uses fenrir_v1 here so you're not repeating hraesvelgr_v2 from S5a, against skoll_v2 as the other listed applier.   [you: fenrir_v1 | opponent: skoll_v2]
